Business.reel: A short film of human progress: from the first writing, the pyramids and the Parthenon, through Euclid, the Pantheon, Brunelleschi's dome, the printing press, Leonardo, Magellan, Newton, the steam engine, the X-ray, flight, the Hoover Dam, the Moon landing, the microchip and the Hubble Deep Field, then faster and faster to light speed, and into a black hole.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
sections.body: Dr. Paraskevas Pakataridis, based in Amaliada, Greece, is responsible for the personal data collected through this website.

sections.heading: What is collected
sections.body: Only what you enter in the appointment form: your name, email address, an optional phone number, the subject of your enquiry and your message.

sections.heading: Why it is used
sections.body: Solely to respond to your request and, where appropriate, to arrange an appointment or meeting. Your details are never used for marketing, sold or shared with third parties for their own purposes.

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Your consent, given when you submit the form (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR). You may withdraw it at any time.

sections.heading: How it is handled
sections.body: Requests are delivered by email through a trusted email service provider, which may process data outside the European Union under appropriate safeguards. Please do not send detailed medical records through the form; clinical matters are discussed in person.

sections.heading: How long it is kept
sections.body: Your enquiry is kept only for as long as needed to respond and for any follow-up you request, and is then deleted.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may ask to access, correct or delete your data, or object to its processing, by sending a request through the form. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).

sections.heading: Analytics and cookies
sections.body: This website uses privacy-friendly, cookie-free analytics to understand overall visits. A single functional cookie remembers your language preference.
